catalog_record.title: Drum Frieze with Mithuna Couples and Buddhist Narratives
catalog_record.scan_source: Daniel Pett; photogrammetry from 118 iPhone 13 photographs, May 2023
catalog_record.note: Two mithuna couples share this limestone frieze with episodes from the life of the Buddha. Made for the stupa at Amaravati, the panel places intimate human pairs alongside scenes of departure, veneration and spiritual transformation.
